277     def _format_bedrock_messages(self, messages: Messages) -> Messages:
278         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
279 
280         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
281         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
282         - Cleaning tool result content blocks by removing additional fields that may be
283           useful for retaining information in hooks but would cause Bedrock validation
284           exceptions when presented with unexpected fields
285         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
286 
287         Args:
288             messages: List of messages to format
289 
290         Returns:
291             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
292 
293         Note:
294             Bedrock will throw validation exceptions when presented with additional
295             unexpected fields in tool result blocks.
296             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolResultBlock.html
297         """
298         cleaned_messages = []
299 
300         filtered_unknown_members = False
301         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
302 
303         for message in messages:
304             cleaned_content: list[ContentBlock] = []
305 
306             for content_block in message["content"]:
307                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
308                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
309                     filtered_unknown_members = True
310                     continue
311 
312                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent
313                 # TODO: Replace with systematic model configuration registry (https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/780)
314                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:
315                     dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = True
316                     continue
317 
318                 if "toolResult" in content_block:
319                     # Create a new content block with only the cleaned toolResult
320                     tool_result: ToolResult = content_block["toolResult"]
321 
322                     if self._should_include_tool_result_status():
323                         # Include status field
324                         cleaned_tool_result = ToolResult(
325                             content=tool_result["content"],
326                             toolUseId=tool_result["toolUseId"],
327                             status=tool_result["status"],
328                         )
329                     else:
330                         # Remove status field
331                         cleaned_tool_result = ToolResult(  # type: ignore[typeddict-item]
332                             toolUseId=tool_result["toolUseId"], content=tool_result["content"]
333                         )
334 
335                     cleaned_block: ContentBlock = {"toolResult": cleaned_tool_result}
336                     cleaned_content.append(cleaned_block)
337                 else:
338                     # Keep other content blocks as-is
339                     cleaned_content.append(content_block)
340 
341             # Create new message with cleaned content (skip if empty for DeepSeek)
342             if cleaned_content:
343                 cleaned_message: Message = Message(content=cleaned_content, role=message["role"])
344                 cleaned_messages.append(cleaned_message)
345 
346         if filtered_unknown_members:
347             logger.warning(
348                 "Filtered out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks from messages, consider upgrading boto3 version"
349             )
350         if dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content:
351             logger.debug(
352                 "Filtered DeepSeek reasoningContent content blocks from messages - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model#multi-round-conversation"
353             )
354 
355         return cleaned_messages

461     def _stream(

463         callback: Callable[..., None],
464         messages: Messages,

467     ) -> None:
468         """Stream conversation with the Bedrock model.
469 
470         This method operates in a separate thread to avoid blocking the async event loop with the call to
471         Bedrock's converse_stream.
472 
473         Args:
474             callback: Function to send events to the main thread.
475             messages: List of message objects to be processed by the model.
476             tool_specs: List of tool specifications to make available to the model.
477             system_prompt: System prompt to provide context to the model.
478 
479         Raises:
480             ContextWindowOverflowException: If the input exceeds the model's context window.
481             ModelThrottledException: If the model service is throttling requests.
482         """
483         try:
484             logger.debug("formatting request")
485             request = self.format_request(messages, tool_specs, system_prompt)
486             logger.debug("request=<%s>", request)
487 
488             logger.debug("invoking model")

491             logger.debug("got response from model")

493                 response = self.client.converse_stream(**request)

498                         "metadata" in chunk

507                     # Track if we see tool use events

510 
511                     # Fix stopReason for streaming responses that contain tool use

513                         has_tool_use

516                     ):

523                     else:

525 
526             else:
527                 response = self.client.converse(**request)

531                 if (

581     def _convert_non_streaming_to_streaming(self, response: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[StreamEvent]:
582         """Convert a non-streaming response to the streaming format.
583 
584         Args:
585             response: The non-streaming response from the Bedrock model.
586 
587         Returns:
588             An iterable of response events in the streaming format.
589         """
590         # Yield messageStart event
591         yield {"messageStart": {"role": response["output"]["message"]["role"]}}
592 
593         # Process content blocks
594         for content in cast(list[ContentBlock], response["output"]["message"]["content"]):
595             # Yield contentBlockStart event if needed
596             if "toolUse" in content:
597                 yield {
598                     "contentBlockStart": {
599                         "start": {
600                             "toolUse": {
601                                 "toolUseId": content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"],
602                                 "name": content["toolUse"]["name"],
603                             }
604                         },
605                     }
606                 }
607 
608                 # For tool use, we need to yield the input as a delta
609                 input_value = json.dumps(content["toolUse"]["input"])
610 
611                 yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"toolUse": {"input": input_value}}}}
612             elif "text" in content:
613                 # Then yield the text as a delta
614                 yield {
615                     "contentBlockDelta": {
616                         "delta": {"text": content["text"]},
617                     }
618                 }
619             elif "reasoningContent" in content:
620                 # Then yield the reasoning content as a delta
621                 yield {
622                     "contentBlockDelta": {
623                         "delta": {"reasoningContent": {"text": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["text"]}}
624                     }
625                 }
626 
627                 if "signature" in content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]:
628                     yield {
629                         "contentBlockDelta": {
630                             "delta": {
631                                 "reasoningContent": {
632                                     "signature": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["signature"]
633                                 }
634                             }
635                         }
636                     }
637             elif "citationsContent" in content:
638                 # For non-streaming citations, emit text and metadata deltas in sequence
639                 # to match streaming behavior where they flow naturally
640                 if "content" in content["citationsContent"]:
641                     text_content = "".join([content["text"] for content in content["citationsContent"]["content"]])
642                     yield {
643                         "contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"text": text_content}},
644                     }
645 
646                 for citation in content["citationsContent"]["citations"]:
647                     # Then emit citation metadata (for structure)
648 
649                     citation_metadata: CitationsDelta = {
650                         "title": citation["title"],
651                         "location": citation["location"],
652                         "sourceContent": citation["sourceContent"],
653                     }
654                     yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"citation": citation_metadata}}}
655 
656             # Yield contentBlockStop event
657             yield {"contentBlockStop": {}}

278         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
279 
280         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
281         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
282         - Cleaning tool result content blocks by removing additional fields that may be
283           useful for retaining information in hooks but would cause Bedrock validation
284           exceptions when presented with unexpected fields
285         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
286

288             messages: List of messages to format

291             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
292

294             Bedrock will throw validation exceptions when presented with additional
295             unexpected fields in tool result blocks.
296             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolResultBlock.html
297         """
298         cleaned_messages = []
299 
300         filtered_unknown_members = False
301         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
302 
303         for message in messages:
304             cleaned_content: list[ContentBlock] = []
305 
306             for content_block in message["content"]:
307                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
308                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
309                     filtered_unknown_members = True
310                     continue
311 
312                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent

314                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:

507                     # Track if we see tool use events

531                 if (

581     def _convert_non_streaming_to_streaming(self, response: dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[StreamEvent]:
582         """Convert a non-streaming response to the streaming format.
583 
584         Args:
585             response: The non-streaming response from the Bedrock model.
586 
587         Returns:
588             An iterable of response events in the streaming format.
589         """
590         # Yield messageStart event
591         yield {"messageStart": {"role": response["output"]["message"]["role"]}}
592 
593         # Process content blocks
594         for content in cast(list[ContentBlock], response["output"]["message"]["content"]):
595             # Yield contentBlockStart event if needed
596             if "toolUse" in content:
597                 yield {
598                     "contentBlockStart": {
599                         "start": {
600                             "toolUse": {
601                                 "toolUseId": content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"],
602                                 "name": content["toolUse"]["name"],
603                             }
604                         },
605                     }
606                 }
607 
608                 # For tool use, we need to yield the input as a delta
609                 input_value = json.dumps(content["toolUse"]["input"])
610 
611                 yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"toolUse": {"input": input_value}}}}
612             elif "text" in content:
613                 # Then yield the text as a delta
614                 yield {
615                     "contentBlockDelta": {
616                         "delta": {"text": content["text"]},
617                     }
618                 }
619             elif "reasoningContent" in content:
620                 # Then yield the reasoning content as a delta
621                 yield {
622                     "contentBlockDelta": {
623                         "delta": {"reasoningContent": {"text": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["text"]}}
624                     }
625                 }
626 
627                 if "signature" in content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]:
628                     yield {
629                         "contentBlockDelta": {
630                             "delta": {
631                                 "reasoningContent": {
632                                     "signature": content["reasoningContent"]["reasoningText"]["signature"]
633                                 }
634                             }
635                         }
636                     }
637             elif "citationsContent" in content:
638                 # For non-streaming citations, emit text and metadata deltas in sequence
639                 # to match streaming behavior where they flow naturally
640                 if "content" in content["citationsContent"]:
641                     text_content = "".join([content["text"] for content in content["citationsContent"]["content"]])
642                     yield {
643                         "contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"text": text_content}},
644                     }
645 
646                 for citation in content["citationsContent"]["citations"]:
647                     # Then emit citation metadata (for structure)
648 
649                     citation_metadata: CitationsDelta = {
650                         "title": citation["title"],
651                         "location": citation["location"],
652                         "sourceContent": citation["sourceContent"],
653                     }
654                     yield {"contentBlockDelta": {"delta": {"citation": citation_metadata}}}
655 
656             # Yield contentBlockStop event
657             yield {"contentBlockStop": {}}
658 
659         # Yield messageStop event
660         # Fix stopReason for models that return end_turn when they should return tool_use on non-streaming side
661         current_stop_reason = response["stopReason"]
662         if current_stop_reason == "end_turn":
663             message_content = response["output"]["message"]["content"]
664             if any("toolUse" in content for content in message_content):
665                 current_stop_reason = "tool_use"
666                 logger.warning("Override stop reason from end_turn to tool_use")
667 
668         yield {
669             "messageStop": {
670                 "stopReason": current_stop_reason,
671                 "additionalModelResponseFields": response.get("additionalModelResponseFields"),
672             }
673         }
674 
675         # Yield metadata event
676         if "usage" in response or "metrics" in response or "trace" in response:
677             metadata: StreamEvent = {"metadata": {}}
678             if "usage" in response:
679                 metadata["metadata"]["usage"] = response["usage"]
680             if "metrics" in response:
681                 metadata["metadata"]["metrics"] = response["metrics"]
682             if "trace" in response:
683                 metadata["metadata"]["trace"] = response["trace"]
684             yield metadata
685 
686     def _find_detected_and_blocked_policy(self, input: Any) -> bool:
687         """Recursively checks if the assessment contains a detected and blocked guardrail.
688 
689         Args:
690             input: The assessment to check.
691 
692         Returns:
693             True if the input contains a detected and blocked guardrail, False otherwise.
694 
695         """
696         # Check if input is a dictionary
697         if isinstance(input, dict):
698             # Check if current dictionary has action: BLOCKED and detected: true
699             if input.get("action") == "BLOCKED" and input.get("detected") and isinstance(input.get("detected"), bool):
700                 return True
701 
702             # Recursively check all values in the dictionary
703             for value in input.values():
704                 if isinstance(value, dict):
705                     return self._find_detected_and_blocked_policy(value)
706                 # Handle case where value is a list of dictionaries
707                 elif isinstance(value, list):
708                     for item in value:
709                         return self._find_detected_and_blocked_policy(item)
710         elif isinstance(input, list):
711             # Handle case where input is a list of dictionaries
712             for item in input:
713                 return self._find_detected_and_blocked_policy(item)
714         # Otherwise return False
715         return False

725         """Get structured output from the model.

728             output_model: The output model to use for the agent.
729             prompt: The prompt messages to use for the agent.
730             system_prompt: System prompt to provide context to the model.
731             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
732

734             Model events with the last being the structured output.
735         """
736         tool_spec = convert_pydantic_to_tool_spec(output_model)
737 
738         response = self.stream(
739             messages=prompt,
740             tool_specs=[tool_spec],
741             system_prompt=system_prompt,
742             **kwargs,
743         )
744         async for event in streaming.process_stream(response):
745             yield event
746 
747         stop_reason, messages, _, _ = event["stop"]
748 
749         if stop_reason != "tool_use":
750             raise ValueError(f'Model returned stop_reason: {stop_reason} instead of "tool_use".')
751 
752         content = messages["content"]
753         output_response: dict[str, Any] | None = None
754         for block in content:
755             # if the tool use name doesn't match the tool spec name, skip, and if the block is not a tool use, skip.
756             # if the tool use name never matches, raise an error.
757             if block.get("toolUse") and block["toolUse"]["name"] == tool_spec["name"]:
758                 output_response = block["toolUse"]["input"]
759             else:
760                 continue
761 
762         if output_response is None:
763             raise ValueError("No valid tool use or tool use input was found in the Bedrock response.")
